audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers call level 1 'Skill' while the why underneath it says 'you own nothing here', and both give Poppy first item and 2+ items while whys[5] and whys[6] say Kayle out-DPSes a tank who cannot close and Poppy has no carry threat.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Poppy / Poppy / Poppy / Skill / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle. Kayle wins 51.93%; a tank with no scaling payoff cannot own her item stages, and level 6 going ranged against a wall-dependent gap-closer is a clear flip.
audit.corrected: Row 0 -> Poppy, row 4 -> Kayle, row 5 -> Kayle, row 6 -> Kayle; rows 1, 2, 3 unchanged. Flipped in matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Poppy levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, and Keeper's Verdict as a standing threat window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hammer Shock is called a knockup in five places (whys[0], spikes[0], early twice, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0]). Riot's text: it deals damage and creates a zone that slows and explodes after a delay — there is no knockup. Poppy's only displacement is Keeper's Verdict (R) and the wall-pin from Heroic Charge. Packet also flags that no Poppy ability is ever named in the content layer.
audit.why: A player expecting an airborne knockup will misjudge both the trade and the escape: the real punish is a lingering slow zone on a 4-8s cooldown, which you walk out of, not a displacement you cannot act during.
audit.corrected: Call it Hammer Shock's slow-and-explode zone (8/7/6/5/4s), name Heroic Charge as a 14/13/12/11/10s dash that only stuns against a wall, and name Keeper's Verdict as the knockback.

audit.why: The existing observation that Steadfast Presence's anti-dash effect is half-wasted on Kayle is right — nothing in Kayle's kit is a dash, so the W grounding never applies to her. Correctly stated in early already.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[6] calls Starfire Spellblade a 'percent-HP shred'.
audit.why: Riot's text: bonus damage proportionate to their MISSING health. Against a full-health tank that is the opposite of percent max health — it rewards fighting her low, not fighting her at all.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Poppy's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and her only gap-close is a Heroic Charge that needs a wall behind you — step off terrain and she cannot reach you.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heroic Charge's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's on-hit plus E's missing-health damage out-DPS a tank stuck outside your range.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Poppy carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Your AoE waves melt her stacked resistances and she has no carry threat — only Keeper's Verdict buys her time.

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — 14/13/12/11/10s dash that only stuns if it pins you to a wall. Stay off terrain. - Keeper's Verdict: 140/120/100s knockback. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Poppy's Q knockup and heavier base melee autos beat your short pre-form range at level 1 — you own nothing here.
edits.after: Hammer Shock's slow zone and her heavier base melee autos beat your short pre-form range at 1 — you own nothing here.

edits.before: Your E percent-HP shred and full-AoE level-16 scaling melt her stacked defenses — she has no carry threat to reclaim the lane.
edits.after: Starfire Spellblade's missing-health damage and full-AoE level-16 scaling melt her defenses — she has no carry threat to reclaim it.

edits.before: Poppy's Q knockup, base tankiness and heavier melee autos beat your weak pre-6 form — concede these levels and farm safe.
edits.after: Hammer Shock's slow-and-explode zone on 8s, base tankiness and heavier melee autos beat your pre-6 form — concede these levels.

edits.before: All-in levels 1-3 with Q knockup while you're still a short-range melee with no form
edits.after: All-in levels 1-3 with Hammer Shock's slow while you're a short-range melee with no form

edits.before: Survive levels 1-5 by last-hitting at melee tip and sidestepping her Q knockup so you reach 6 healthy
edits.after: Survive levels 1-5 by last-hitting at melee tip and stepping out of Hammer Shock's zone to reach 6 healthy

edits.before: Poppy's anti-dash kit is half-wasted on you — you have no gap-closer for her W to block — but she still owns these levels on raw base tankiness and her Q knockup. Don't melee-trade into her: her autos hit harder and she punishes any step-up with Q while you're still a short-range, pre-form Kayle. Last-hit at the very tip of your range, sidestep the Q knockup hitbox, and never hug a wall where her E can pin you for the stun. Concede CS rather than feed an all-in you can't win yet.
edits.after: Poppy's anti-dash kit is half-wasted on you — you have no dash for Steadfast Presence to stop — but she owns these levels on raw base tankiness and Hammer Shock. Don't melee-trade her: her autos hit harder and she punishes any step-up with a 4-8s slow zone while you're a short-range, pre-form Kayle. Last-hit at the tip of your range, walk out of the zone before it explodes, and never hug a wall where Heroic Charge can pin you. Concede CS rather than feed an all-in you can't win.

notes: The knockup error ran through five separate strings and all five are corrected here — a player reading the old page would brace for a displacement that does not exist and stand in a slow zone that does. Poppy has no anti-heal, so Celestial Blessing sustains her chip freely; not added anywhere for length reasons but worth a line if space opens.
